# Longbridge Research

⚠️ **Trading warning / Avertissement trading** : informational only, not investment advice. Analyst consensus is a lagging average of other people's opinions, and insiders sell for many reasons that have nothing to do with the stock. Curated by Skill Harbor: the research skill of the Longbridge platform, published by the broker itself. Through the Longbridge CLI it serves institution ratings (buy, hold and sell distribution with recent rating events), forward EPS and revenue forecasts, the consensus price target, a finance calendar of upcoming earnings, dividends, IPOs and macro events, institutional shareholders and fund or ETF holders, SEC Form 4 insider trade history for US stocks, SEC 13F institutional portfolio holdings, undisclosed short positions over time and daily short sale volume, and industry ranking lists with peer group trees. Its frameworks turn that data into research work: investment idea generation, a structured investment proposal memo, a five-step coverage initiation report, a stock research snapshot, competitive analysis with Porter five forces and moat assessment, an investment thesis tracker, post-investment monitoring against plan, Hong Kong IPO analysis, financial planning work (retirement, education funding, cash flow), and company profiles and tear sheets. All CLI commands here are public, no login required. From the longbridge/skills repository (MIT). Honest caveats: two sections, DeFi yield and on-chain analysis, do not come from Longbridge data...
